name: dev.ucp.shopping.verity
title: Verity Market Truth Extension (DRAFT)
description: Extends Catalog Search, Catalog Lookup and Cart with provable market pricing: live market price next to the store price, freshness ages, short-term price pulse, price history and an append-only ledger reference. Never carries cost, markup or margin.

market_observed_at.description: When the most recent market observation backing market_price was recorded.

checked_at.description: When the business last re-validated its own price against market.

pulse.description: Market price change over a window, in basis points (1500 = +15.00%).

amount.description: Market price at t, ISO 4217 minor units.

signals.description: The only value signals a storefront may show. Wholesale cost, markup and margin are out of scope by design.

condition.description: Condition the market_price is quoted for.

history.description: Down-sampled series for sparklines (e.g. 30 points / 30 days).

ledger_ref.description: Link to the append-only ledger entry behind the current store price.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Verity
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Each line item carries a market check at add time so the agent can say 'you never overpaid'.

verity.description: Map of line item id → verity_pricing.
